blocks.zh: 附录C 人类研究详情

blocks.en: C.1. Pair Allocation and Exposure Balancing
blocks.zh: C.1. 配给和曝光平衡

blocks.en: We allocated comparisons using an exposure-balanced sampling procedure designed to distribute judgments approximately evenly across the 306 cases shown to crowdworkers. For each comparison, cases previously encountered by the participant were excluded. Among the remaining eligible cases, the 30 with the fewest prior comparisons were identified, and two distinct cases were sampled uniformly from this set. This procedure prioritized underexposed cases without using their estimated priority scores to determine sampling probabilities. To support exploratory analyses of agreement, we also prespecified 30 anchor pairs. Each comparison request had a 10% probability of presenting an eligible anchor pair instead of a pair generated through exposure balancing. Anchor comparisons were included in the Bradley–Terry analysis identically to other comparisons. The resulting exposure distribution was approximately uniform among non-anchor cases: 262 of 263 (99.6%) appeared in 50–53 comparisons, including 242 appearing in exactly 50 or 51.
blocks.zh: 我们利用一个接触平衡的抽样程序进行了比较,目的是在向人群工作者显示的306个案件中,大致均衡地分配判决。 每项比较均不包括参与人以前遇到的情况。 在其余符合资格的个案中,确定了先前比较最少的30个个案,从这一组个案中统一抽取了两个不同的个案。 这一程序优先处理未充分曝光的案件,而不使用估计优先得分来确定采样概率。 为了支持对协议的探索性分析,我们还预先确定了30对锚。 每项比较请求都有10%的概率显示合格锚对,而不是通过接触平衡产生的一对。 Bradley-Terry分析中包含的锚地比较与其他比较相同。 由此产生的接触分布在非定点病例中大致一致:263起(99.6%)中有262起出现在50-53起比较中,其中242起出现在50起或51起。

blocks.en: C.2. Participant Compensation and Data Quality
blocks.zh: C.2. 参加者的报酬和数据质量

blocks.en: Participants received $3.00 per approved submission, corresponding to a planned hourly compensation of $18.00 for a 10-minute task. Among completed submissions, Phase 1 participants ( n = 199 n=199 ) had a mean completion time of 7.87 minutes (median 6.93, SD 4.22), equivalent to $22.87 per hour based on mean completion time. Phase 2 participants ( n = 301 n=301 ) had a mean completion time of 10.19 minutes (median 9.02, SD 5.07), equivalent to $17.66 per hour. Across both phases ( n = 500 n=500 ), the mean completion time was 9.27 minutes (median 8.32, SD 4.88), corresponding to an effective hourly equivalent of $19.42. We did not administer explicit attention-check questions. Instead, we used Prolific’s functionality for identifying exceptionally fast submissions as a data-quality safeguard.

blocks.en: D.1. Sensitivity to Bradley–Terry Regularization
blocks.zh: D.1. 对布拉德利-特里正规化的敏感性

blocks.en: The Bradley–Terry model uses an L 2 L_{2} penalty with coefficient λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , specified in the study plan before Phase 1 data collection. Because regularization shrinks case-level priority estimates toward zero, it could affect the decomposition of priority variation across and within activity domains. To assess this sensitivity, we refitted the model across nine penalty coefficients spanning λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 to λ = 10 \lambda=10 and recomputed the proportion of case-level BT variance attributable to differences between the 17 ATUS Tier-1 domains. Across these settings, the between-domain variance share ranged from 10.6% to 11.4%, compared with 11.3% at the prespecified λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 . Although stronger regularization substantially compressed the absolute range of BT estimates, the relative decomposition remained stable. These findings indicate that the observed predominance of within-domain variation is not sensitive to the selected regularization coefficient over the tested range.

blocks.en: The regularization sensitivity analysis measures the unadjusted share of estimated case-priority variance attributable to differences between domains. This measure is distinct from the chance-adjusted ω 2 \omega^{2} reported in the main text and should not be interpreted as a replacement for it. Across the tested penalty coefficients, most estimated case-level priority variation remained within domains.

blocks.en: E.2. Targets of Participant Reflections
blocks.zh: E.2. 与会者反思的目标

blocks.en: In addition to substantive thematic codes, we annotated whether each reflection discussed the case the participant selected, the case they rejected, both cases, or an unclear target. Reflections about the selected case were left unmarked by convention; all other target types received an explicit annotation. Of the 451 substantive reflections, 389 concerned the selected case, 43 concerned both cases, 13 concerned the rejected case, and six were unclear or mismatched. We used these annotations to avoid interpreting comments about rejected cases as reasons for their selection.
blocks.zh: 除了实质性的专题守则外,我们还对每次思考是否讨论参与者选择的案件、他们拒绝的案件(两个案例)或不明确的目标作了说明。 公约对选定案例的反思未作标记;所有其他目标类型都得到了明确的说明。 在451起实质性反思中,389起涉及选定的案件,43起涉及两个案件,13起涉及被驳回的案件,有6起不清楚或不匹配。 我们使用这些说明是为了避免解释关于驳回案件的评论,作为选择这些案件的理由。
